acceptance: Effect classes order read-only, idempotent, conditional, non-idempotent, destructive, indeterminate; joins keep the more dangerous, unproven means indeterminate, a declared effect can never be weaker than any asserted effect, and heuristic or user evidence never yields verified.

positive.fixture: effect join and certainty combine laws plus 104 mutation cases report exactly the expected codes

negative.fixture: understated effects, overclaimed certainty, unresolved conflicts and type-mismatched claims are each reported

security_and_source_permissions: Contracts carry no credentials; documents declare required scopes and authorized contexts, and source-account permissions stay separate from VSF caller authentication.
performance_memory_storage: Validators are linear in document size; no allocation beyond violation lists.
known_limitations: Go reaches semantic checks through the native worker rather than reimplementing them
